Open the [either/or search prototype](http://maker:4001/index.html?flow=advanced-search&control=builder&logic=or). Under **Label is**, select both **Design** and **Reference**, leaving **Match any selected** in place. Confirm that you get two bookmarks—one carrying Design and the other Reference—while the Books bookmark stays out.

I’ve assumed either/or applies within the selected-label group, while an exact phrase or excluded site can still further narrow that combined group.
